title: Photo cake with their face on it? 100% eggless, from Riverstone
summary:
Want a photo cake for a Stanhope Gardens or Marsden Park birthday, and every bakery says it's not sure about the eggs?

We add your photo to any 100% eggless cake for $19.99. Pick a size from 6 inch at $39.99 up to 16 inch for 50 guests, then choose from 15 flavours including Mango, Tiramisu and Rasmalai.

Send your photo and your date when you order. Pickup is from Shop 8, Riverstone Shopping Centre, with free parking right at the door. Order two days ahead and we'll have it ready.
